enterprise to become data-driven and aligned with the overall business strategy.</li> <li>You will consult on complex data programs, providing technical leadership and guidance as a data subject-matter expert.</li> <li>You will lead and interact with clients across various domains, addressing challenging problems, and collaborate with sales to turn them into viable solutions and winning proposals.</li> <li>You will act as a translator between business, data and IT, and communicate data strategy to senior client stakeholders, including C-level.</li> <li>You will own the creation of end-to-end viable data solutions, keeping in mind long-term impacts and overseeing program inceptions for new product development.</li> <li>You will be responsible for formulating data governance strategies addressing security, privacy and compliance requirements.</li> <li>You will enable capability building in data strategy and governance, growing the next generation of data strategists.</li> <li>You will create differentiated assets in data strategy and governance to take to market.</li> <li>You lead through influence rather than headcount: growing capability and raising delivery standards inside the organisation, while building our presence in the market through thought leadership, ecosystem initiatives and client-facing points of view.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Job qualifications</strong></p> <p><strong>Technical Skills</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have extensive experience as a consultant, with a proven track record of creating data strategy and solutions that drive business value.</li> <li>You have solid experience with data platforms and technologies, and can provide advisory and consultative guidance for clients and cross-delivery teams.</li> <li>You have experience engaging with C-level stakeholders to influence and enable the operationalization of an enterprise-wide data strategy.</li> <li>You have demonstrated leadership abilities, with the capacity to lead technical teams and drive projects to successful completion.</li> <li>You are flexible and adaptable across a variety of projects, leveraging technical expertise and leadership to maximise impact.</li> <li>You have a track record of ensuring proper data governance policies, including data lineage, quality checks and classification.</li> <li>You have experience with AI and ML use cases and landscapes and can influence the build of the right solutions to harness insights from data.</li> <li>You have experience building high-level solution frameworks, leveraging paradigms such as data-as-a-product and federated governance where needed.</li> <li>You have professional working proficiency in German (B2 minimum, C1 strongly preferred) and can build consensus with mostly technical stakeholders. record</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have worked in a consultancy or professional-services environment within the last five years, driving data and AI engagements end to end (recent examples matter more than historical ones).</li> <li>You can point to data and AI pursuits you helped win and shape within the last three to five years, including deals from around €3M upwards, and you can speak concretely to their commercial shape, trade-offs and delivery.</li> <li>You have grown a practice, capability or go-to-market asset, for example a reusable accelerator taken to market, combining solutioning, sales and delivery with tangible business outcomes.</li> <li>You stay conversant with the technology and hands-on enough in at least one relevant area to earn technical credibility with client and delivery teams, while leading primarily on strategy and advisory.</li> <li>You bring significant hands-on and leadership experience in data and AI (typically 10+ years) and, above all, the appetite to keep building: growing accounts, teams and capability rather than only overseeing them.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Professional Skills</strong></p> <ul> <li>You understand the importance of stakeholder management and can easily liaise between clients and other key stakeholders, ensuring buy-in and gaining trust along the way.</li> <li>You are resilient in ambiguous situations and can adapt your role to approach challenges from multiple perspectives.</li> <li>You don't shy away from risks or conflicts, instead you take them on and skillfully manage them.</li> <li>You coach, mentor and motivate others and aspire to influence teammates to take positive action and accountability for their work.</li> <li>You enjoy influencing others and always advocate for technical excellence while being open to change when needed.</li> <li>Cultivating strong partnerships comes naturally to you; you understand how relationship building brings new opportunities to our business.</li> <li>You have professional working proficiency in German (B2 minimum, C1 strongly preferred) and can build consensus with mostly technical stakeholders. Exceptional candidates with outstanding data and AI consulting credentials may be considered where German is not yet at this level.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Other things to know</strong></p> <p><strong>Learning &amp; Development</strong></p> <p>There is no one-size-fits-all career path at Thoughtworks: however you want to develop your career is entirely up to you. But we also balance autonomy with the strength of our cultivation culture. This means your career is supported by interactive tools, numerous development programs and teammates who want to help you grow. We see value in helping each other be our best and that extends to empowering our employees in their career journeys.</p> <p><strong>Responsible Use of AI in Recruitment</strong></p> <p>At Thoughtworks, we use AI tools to support our recruitment team with administrative tasks such as drafting communications, scheduling interviews and writing job descriptions.</p> <p>Crucially, our AI tools do not screen, assess, rank or make hiring decisions. We hold our third-party vendors to these same high standards through a rigorous governance process. For additional information, please see our full Thoughtworks AI Policy for Recruitment.</p> <p><strong>About Thoughtworks</strong></p> <p>Thoughtworks is a dynamic and inclusive community of bright and supportive colleagues who are revolutionizing tech. As a leading technology consultancy, we're pushing boundaries through our purposeful and impactful work. For 30+ years, we've delivered extraordinary impact together with our clients by helping them solve complex business problems with technology as the differentiator. Bring your brilliant expertise and commitment for continuous learning to Thoughtworks. Together, let's be extraordinary.</p> <p><br><br></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p style="text-align: center;"><a href="https://www.thoughtworks.com/careers/ai-policy-for-recruitment">See here our AI policy.</a></p></div> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer (m/w/d)
description: Als Senior Machine Learning Engineer arbeitest du im Pricing & Revenue-Kontext an datengetriebenen Verbesserungen für Forecasting, Pricing-Logiken und Produkt-Insights. Du baust Analysen und Modelle, die im Produkt messbar Wirkung zeigen – mit sauberer Evaluation, solider Datenbasis und pragmatischer Umsetzung. Du arbeitest dabei eng mit Product & Engineering zusammen. Deine Aufgaben Model Evolution: Du entwickelst und optimierst unsere Forecasting- und Pricing-Modelle sowie datengetriebene Decision-Logiken, immer methodisch pragmatisch und voll auf Impact ausgerichtet. Signal Hunting: Du arbeitest mit Zeitreihen, Demand-Signalen und heterogenen Datenquellen. Du definierst Features und Labels so sauber, dass Leakage keine Chance hat. Measurement & Guardrails: Du verantwortest die Evaluation durch Backtests, robuste Metriken und Segmentierungen. Du unterstützt bei Holdouts sowie A/B-Logiken und behältst den Check zwischen Offline- und Online-Performance. Best Practices im ML Engineering: Du setzt neue Maßstäbe für Backtesting, Reproduzierbarkeit und Versionierung. Für uns zählt: Engineering-Qualität statt reiner Notebook-Lösungen. Data Visibility: Du baust Dashboards und Reports aus, die Modell- und Business-KPIs transparent machen. Dein Fokus liegt dabei immer auf höchster Data Quality. Smart Workflows: Du treibst reproduzierbare Workflows voran (Versionierung, saubere Pipelines, sinnvolle Tests) und automatisierst wiederkehrende Analysen sowie Evaluationsläufe. Dein Profil Track Record: Du hast 4+ Jahre Erfahrung in Data Science oder Applied ML Engineering gesammelt – idealerweise direkt im Produkt- oder Business-Kontext. Data Intuition: Du besitzt extrem starke SQL-Skills und ein tiefes Gespür für Datenqualität, Debugging und konsistente Metriken. Python Pro: Dein Python-Code ist sauber und deine Analysen sind nachvollziehbar. Erste Erfahrung mit produktnahen Setups ist ein großes Plus. Experiment-Mindset: Du beherrscht die Grundlagen von Bias/Leakage-Awareness und weißt, wie man in Guardrails und Offline-vs-Online-Szenarien denkt. Work Style: Du übernimmst volle Ownership für deine Themen. Du arbeitest nach dem 80/20-Prinzip (pragmatisch!), bist zuverlässig und kommunizierst glasklar. Entrepreneurial Spirit: Du denkst unternehmerisch und willst Dinge wirklich bewegen. Sprachkenntnisse: Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und bringst gute Englischkenntnisse mit. Nice‑to‑haves – was die Besten auszeichnet Domain Expertise: Du hast bereits Erfahrung im Revenue Management oder Dynamic Pricing (z. B. Hotel, Travel, eCommerce oder Mobility). Demand Knowledge: Du kennst dich mit Saisonalität, Events, Lead Times und Segment-Mustern aus. Modern Stack: Du hast schon mit Analytics Engineering oder Warehouse-Tools wie dbt, Snowflake oder Metabase gearbeitet. Hands-on MLOps & Cloud: Ein Plus ist praktische Erfahrung im Umgang mit MLOps-Tools und Cloud-Infrastruktur, z. B. AWS. Wir sind angetreten, um die Hotellerie nicht nur zu digitalisieren, sondern ihre technologische Basis auf ein neues Level zu heben. Wenn du Lust hast, die Verantwortung für das technische Rückgrat eines Millionen-Portfolios zu übernehmen und gemeinsam mit uns die nächste Generation des automatisierten Revenue Managements zu skalieren, dann lass uns reden! title: Senior Security Engineer (m/f/d)
description: Your mission Do you want to do more than just write security concepts - and put your decisions into practice directly? Do you see cloud security not as a compliance checklist, but as the combination of threat modeling, Infrastructure as Code, and genuine hands-on engineering? Then we are looking for you to join our CISO team as a Senior Security Engineer (m/f/d) in a hybrid working model in Munich, Berlin or Halle (Saale) . You will join a three-person team where responsibility is genuinely shared: no ticket queues and no “that’s not my area.” We plan together, cover for one another, and usually implement and operate the security controls we design ourselves. This means you will see the impact of your work immediately - not at some point in the distant future. Your Responsibilities Security Architecture & Cloud Guardrails: You will take technical ownership of the security architecture and controls across our Azure environment - from Defender for Cloud and Microsoft Sentinel to Log Analytics. You will build and maintain the corresponding guardrails directly in Terraform. Detection Engineering: You will develop and continuously improve our detections in close collaboration with our Security Analyst, who is responsible for day-to-day SIEM monitoring and triage. You will work as a well-coordinated team rather than in separate silos. Vulnerability Management: You will further develop our vulnerability management and monitoring across a hybrid environment. This includes our growing cloud landscape as well as the existing on-premises stack for as long as the migration is ongoing. Security Beyond the Cloud: You will contribute your expertise beyond cloud security, including identity, endpoint security, application security, incident response, and AI. Using your security engineering skills, you will, for example, develop tooling for AI-assisted penetration testing within our team and translate it into practical, scalable processes. AI-Assisted Engineering: You will use tools such as Claude Code to build and maintain internal security tools and automations. At the same time, you will help us identify AI-specific risks early—from the secure use of AI coding assistants to prompt injection. Your skillset Azure Security & Certifications: You have at least five years of experience in security engineering and several years of hands-on experience implementing Azure security. You hold an AZ-500 certification or have equivalent practical expertise. SC-100, CISSP, CCSP, or Security+ certifications are a plus. Infrastructure & Automation: You can confidently read, write, and further develop security-related Terraform code. Experience with Python, Django, PowerShell, or AI-assisted development is a plus. Identity & Detection: You have practical experience with Entra ID, RBAC, and PIM, as well as solid knowledge of network security, SIEM, and detection engineering. Offensive Security & Vulnerability Management: Ideally, you have experience with traditional or AI-assisted penetration testing and with tools such as Tenable or Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management. Hands-On Mindset: You do not just design security controls -you implement and operate them in practice. When you identify a problem, you do not wait for a ticket; you take ownership and develop a solution. Collaboration & Communication: You share knowledge and responsibility and work closely with the team on areas of joint ownership. You communicate confidently and professionally in English. German is a plus, but not a requirement. Experience with an ongoing cloud migration and AI/LLM security is welcome, but not essential. What matters to us is what you can genuinely do - substance beats buzzword bingo. Your winning deal Your benefits : In addition to 30 days of vacation , we also offer you a job lunch allowance (€69 per month), a “ Givve ” card (topped up with €50 per month) or a subsidized membership with Wellpass, discounts via “ Corporate Benefits” , the option of leasing a JobRad , pension contributions (occupational pension & VL) and great team and company events . Your workplace : Y ou will work in a flexible, hybrid model from one of our dog-friendly and modern offices and will have the opportunity to do “ work from abroad ” within the EU for 2 weeks a year (* only applies to employees with an EU passport ) Your footprint: A position in a profitable company where you have the freedom and confidence to help shape it and work with us on the “ future of work ” . The values : We score highly with an open, authentic culture and a high- performing and humorous team that is already looking forward to making bold decisions with you and breaking new ground that will lead us to sustainable success . title: Buyer Development Sr Director DACH
description: Company at a Glance OpenX is focused on unleashing the full economic potential of digital media companies. We do this by making digital advertising markets and technologies that are designed to deliver optimal value to publishers and advertisers on every ad served across all screens. At OpenX, we have built a team that is uniquely experienced in designing and operating high-scale ad marketplaces, and we are constantly on the lookout for thoughtful, creative executors who are as fascinated as we are about finding new ways to apply a blend of market design, technical innovation, operational excellence, and empathetic partner service to the frontiers of digital advertising. OpenX is looking for a senior, commercially driven Buyer Development leader to establish and grow our demand-side business across DACH. This is the first dedicated Buyer Development role in-market. The role will be directly responsible for generating revenue across agencies, holdcos, and clients / brands, building senior relationships and commercial foundations required for long-term growth. The successful candidate will open senior buyer relationships, build and manage pipeline, progress strategic opportunities, and convert demand-side engagement into measurable revenue outcomes. This is a senior individual contributor role to begin with. As the DACH opportunity matures, the ambition is for this person to help build and potentially lead a broader regional Buyer Development function once clear market proof points have been established. Key Responsibilities: Own Revenue Growth Take direct responsibility for generating and growing buyer-led revenue across agencies, holdcos, and clients / brands in DACH.   Build and manage a qualified pipeline across PMP, curation, SPO, CTV, data-led activation, OpenX Select, premium supply, AI-led solutions, and direct buyer partnerships.   Convert senior relationships into commercial outcomes through consultative selling, strategic account planning, business cases, QBRs, joint business plans, and deal progression. Maintain strong commercial discipline around pipeline, forecasting, revenue progression, and opportunity prioritisation.   Build the Market Establish OpenX’s Buyer Development presence in DACH as the first dedicated in-market hire. Create a clear map of priority buyers, agencies, holdcos, brands, DSPs, data partners, senior decision-makers, trading models, and commercial pathways. Identify where OpenX can create the most meaningful and scalable impact in the region. Build the foundations for a future regional team, including account prioritisation, pipeline discipline, market feedback loops, and cross-functional ways of working. Work Cross-Functionally Work closely with Sales, Account Management, Product, Marketing, global Buyer Development, DSP Strategic Partnerships, and the Data Partner function to shape, activate, measure, and scale DACH opportunities. Partner with DSP Strategic Partnerships to improve buyer access, support SPO conversations, and ensure agency and client demand can be activated efficiently through priority DSP routes. Partner with the Data Partner function to identify relevant data-led opportunities for DACH buyers, including curated marketplaces, audience-led activation, and strategic client solutions. Build OpenX’s Market Presence Represent OpenX as a credible senior voice in the DACH programmatic market. Support OpenX’s visibility through senior meetings, client education, industry events, roundtables, and thought leadership. Position OpenX around key buyer priorities including transparency, sustainability, premium supply, curation, data quality, supply path optimisation, and a healthier digital advertising ecosystem. Requirements: 7+ years of experience as a senior commercial individual contributor with deep knowledge of the DACH programmatic advertising ecosystem and a strong network across agencies, holdcos, brands, DSPs, and strategic partners. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record of revenue ownership, opening senior relationships, building pipeline, and converting strategic opportunities into commercial outcomes. They should be credible with senior clients and partners, highly self-motivated, commercially disciplined, and comfortable building a market from an early-stage position. Fluency in German and English is required. OpenX VALUES Our five company values form a solid bedrock serving to define us as a group and guide the company. Our values remind us that how we do things often matters as much as what we do. WE ARE ONE We are one team. There are no exceptions. We are a group of strong and diverse individuals unified by a shared mission. We embrace challenges and win together as a team. We respect and care about our colleagues and cultivate an inclusive culture WE ARE CUSTOMER CENTRIC We innovate on behalf of our customers. We understand, respect, and listen carefully to our customers. We build great products to solve our customers’ problems. We manage our customers’ expectations clearly and honestly. We are a trusted partner to all of our customers - we act with integrity at all times. We care. OPENX IS OURS We are all owners of OpenX We all have a voice to improve OpenX We stake our personal and professional reputations on the excellence of our work We are not interested in just "doing our jobs"; we take ownership to drive results WE ARE AN OPEN BOOK We understand and respect what each of us does. We are eager to teach and share what we know with others, both internally and externally. We are eager to learn from others and we ask questions internally and externally.  WE EVOLVE FAST We take responsible risks and own and learn from our mistakes. We recognize and repeat success. We actively seek out and provide constructive feedback. We adapt quickly and embrace change. We tackle growth and learning with real urgency. We are endlessly curious. OpenX TRAITS Our three traits capture what makes a great team member at OpenX. HUMBLE Ideal team players are humble and demonstrate integrity. They put the team's success above their own, share credit generously, and value collective achievements. They are self-assured, open to coaching, and committed to continuous learning. DRIVEN Ideal team players are results-driven and motivated. They are curious, always seeking more to do, learn, and take on. As proactive problem-solvers, they take initiative without needing external motivation. They continuously think about the next steps and opportunities for improvement. SMART Ideal team players are smart and possess the intellectual acumen to understand the complexities of our organization and industry. They are interpersonally intelligent, good communicators, and exemplify sound judgment in their interactions across the company to foster a collaborative environment. OpenX is committed to equal employment opportunities. Innerhalb weniger Jahre haben wir Heizung-Billiger de, einen Fachhandel für Haustechnik und Sanitär, zu einer wichtigen Plattform in der Branche gemacht. Moment! Bevor du die Seite schließt: Haustechnik ist viel spannender als du denkst!

Von der Wohnung bis zum Einfamilienhaus, unsere Produkte sind überall zu finden. Und während wir uns alle Gedanken über nachhaltige Energien machen, ist die Haustechnik ein entscheidender Faktor für die Energiewende.

Du möchtest die verschiedenen Aspekte des eCommerce entdecken und weiterentwickeln? Dann bist du bei Heizung Billiger genau richtig! Wir bieten dir die Gelegenheit, dein Studium aktiv mitzugestalten und deine Stärken in verschiedenen Projekten einzubringen.

Wir bieten:

  • Abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeiten mit viel Freiraum
  • Vielfältige Perspektiven in einem expandierenden eCommerce-Unternehmen mit flachen Hierarchien
  • Die Möglichkeit der kreativen Mitgestaltung der weiteren Geschäftsentwicklung

Aufgaben

  • Als Werkstudent (m/w/d) unterstützt du unser Business Development Team im operativen Tagesgeschäft und bekommst so einen umfangreichen Einblick in unser eCommerce Startup
  • Aufbereitung und Auswertung von Vertriebs-, Einkaufs- und Marktdaten; Pflege und Weiterentwicklung bestehender Reports und Dashboards
  • Kommunikation mit Partnern und Lieferanten, Terminvorbereitung, strukturierte Zusammenfassung von Meetings und nächsten Schritten
  • Unterstützung bei der Betreuung wichtiger Bestandskunden und Partner
  • Optimierung des strategischer Einkaufs durch Preisvergleiche, Angebotsauswertungen und Unterstützung bei Verhandlungsunterlagen
  • Einsatz von KI-Tools zur Recherche, Texterstellung und Prozessoptimierung

Qualifikation

  • Du studierst Betriebswirtschaftslehre, Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder einen vergleichbaren Studiengang und hast große Leidenschaft für Entrepreneurship und E-Commerce
  • Du arbeitest gerne eigenständig und bist dafür bekannt, strukturiert und organisiert vorzugehen
  • Du hast Erfahrung und Interesse an KI-Nutzung (z. B. Gemini, Claude, Perplexity, ChatGPT), Excel/GSheets, SQL und BI-Tools
  • Bevor Du lange E-Mails schreibst, greifst Du lieber zum Telefon – und freust Dich darauf, Verhandlungen auch direkt zu übernehmen
  • Du möchtest wertvolle Praxiserfahrung in einem dynamischen Start-up sammeln und Dich weiterentwickeln

Benefits

  • Attraktive und leistungsgerechte Vergütung
  • Inspirierender Start-Up Spirit: Tauche ein in ein sympathisches und hochmotiviertes Team mit gelebten Core Values, flachen Hierarchien und einem harmonischen Umgang auf Augenhöhe
  • Die Möglichkeit, Verantwortung und Eigeninitiative zu übernehmen und eigene Ideen in Deinen Bereichen umzusetzen
  • Flexibles Arbeitsmodell (tageweise auch im Homeoffice möglich)
  • Einblick in viele Bereiche: Business Development, Vertrieb, Einkauf, Key Accounting
  • Ein modernes Büro an einem tollen Standort in Walldorf mit sehr guter Verkehrsanbindung

Wir leisten Pionierarbeit im eCommerce-Bereich des Haustechnik-Marktes und schaffen moderne Handelsketten für private als auch gewerbliche Kunden.

Unsere Arbeitskultur ist locker, aber engagiert. Krawatten? Nicht bei uns. Hier herrscht ein kollegiales "Du", denn wir setzen auf ein offenes und ehrliches Miteinander.

Wir setzen auf Transparenz und einen offenen Dialog. Das bedeutet auch, dass wir uns auf die Ideen und das Engagement jedes Einzelnen von uns verlassen.

Du hast Lust, Teil unseres Teams zu werden und aktiv Verantwortung zu übernehmen? Dann wollen wir dich kennenlernen! Selbst wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllst, zögere nicht, uns deine Bewerbung zu schicken. Deine Motivation und deine Ideen sind uns mindestens genauso wichtig wie dein Lebenslauf.

Wir sind gespannt darauf, von dir zu hören und freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!

Attraktives Paket mit Feingehalt, Firmenwagen und 30 Urlaubstage bei einer 40-Stunden-Woche. Flexibles Arbeiten: Mobiles Arbeiten und kurze Entscheidungswege in einer direkten, pragmatischen Unternehmenskultur. title: Senior Performance Marketing Manager – Performance Marketing, MMM & AI (m/w/d)
description: Du hast den kompletten Performance-Marketing-Mix fest im Griff und nutzt KI im Kampagnenmanagement nicht als Hype, sondern als tägliches Werkzeug? Du möchtest datengetriebene Entscheidungen zur Budgetallokation treffen und aktiv mitgestalten, wie modernste AI-Tools die Steuerung im E-Commerce revolutionieren? Dann wartet in unserem Team in Berlin deine nächste große Challenge auf dich: Bei benuta übernimmst du echte Ownership über unsere Kanäle hinweg und treibst ein echtes Greenfield-Thema voran – die Skalierung KI-gestützter Analysen und Strategien für den europäischen Marktführer im Home-&-Living-Bereich! Deine Aufgaben Strategische Kanal- & Budgetsteuerung: Du entwickelst und verantwortest die kanalübergreifende Performance-Marketing-Strategie via MMM zur Erreichung unserer Unternehmensziele (Umsatz, Effizienz, Lead-Gen, Brand Awareness). Du steuerst und optimierst Kampagnen über Google Ads, Bing Ads, Meta, Pinterest, Reddit Ads sowie Affiliate-Partnerschaften mit einer konsistenten Budget- und Ziellogik. AI-Integration & Workflow-Innovation: Du treibst den Einsatz von LLMs (z. B. Claude, Gemini) für die automatisierte, kanalübergreifende Analyse unserer Kampagnendaten aktiv voran. Du entwickelst Prompts und Workflows für beschleunigtes Reporting, Anomalie-Erkennung sowie Budget-Optimierungen und agierst als interner Expert für KI-gestützte Marketing-Tools. Analyse & Bidding-Evaluierung: Du überwachst und analysierst alle relevanten KPIs (CPO, ROAS, CAC, Conversion Rate) auf Basis von GA4 und unserem serverseitigen Tracking-Setup (server-side GTM). Zudem bewertest du KI-gestützte Bidding- und Automatisierungsfunktionen der Werbeplattformen auf ihren Mehrwert. Tracking-Setup & Datensicherheit: Du implementierst und verwaltest Tracking-Setups (z. B. Conversion-APIs, UTM-Konventionen) und stellst eine saubere, datenschutzkonforme Datengrundlage sicher. Testing: Du verantwortest fortlaufende A/B-Tests und Budget-Experimente zur kontinuierlichen Performance-Steigerung aller Kanäle. Partner-Management & Kollaboration: Du verhandelst und entwickelst Vendor- und Partnerverträge (z. B. im Affiliate-Bereich) weiter. Bei der Kampagnenabstimmung arbeitest du eng mit den Teams aus Design, Content und IT zusammen. Mentoring: Du unterstützt bei der fachlichen Anleitung sowie dem Onboarding von Junior-Kolleg*innen im Team und teilst dein KI-Wissen. Dein Profil Ausbildung: Du hast dein Studium (BWL, Marketing, Medien, Kommunikationswissenschaften o. Ä.) erfolgreich abgeschlossen oder bringst eine vergleichbare Qualifikation mit. Relevante Berufserfahrung: Du bringst mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung im Performance Marketing mit – idealerweise kanalübergreifend (SEA, Paid Social, Affiliate) und mit nachweisbarer Budget- oder Teilprojektverantwortung. Erste Erfahrung in der fachlichen Führung ist von Vorteil. AI-Expertise (Must-have): Du besitzt praxiserprobte Erfahrung im Einsatz von KI-Tools und LLMs im Marketing-Kontext (z. B. Prompting für Reporting, Analysen, Forecasting). Du verfolgst aktuelle AI-Trends aktiv und brennst darauf, diese bei benuta einzubringen. Hard Skills: Du zeichnest dich durch ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten aus, nutzt GA4 sowie gängige Attributions-/Reporting-Tools souverän und hast tiefe Kenntnisse in mindestens einem Zentralkanal (Google Ads, Meta). Erfahrung mit Bing, Pinterest, Reddit, Affiliate und serverseitigem Tracking runden dein Profil ab. Soft Skills: Du arbeitest datengetrieben, denkst lösungsorientiert und begeisterst dich für E-Commerce sowie die Themen Home & Living. Sprachkompetenz: Deine Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse sind sehr gut (weitere Sprachen sind ein Plus). Deine Benefits Impact & Gestaltungsspielraum : Bei uns kannst du aktiv mitgestalten, die Marke benuta weiterentwickeln und spannende KI-Projekte umsetzen – wie etwa den Aufbau KI-gestützter Analyse-Workflows für unsere Kampagnendaten. Deine Ideen werden gehört und du bekommst Freiraum für die Umsetzung eigener Ansätze. Präsenz & Flexibilität: Der Schwerpunkt unserer Arbeit liegt auf dem persönlichen Austausch und der gemeinsamen Zusammenarbeit vor Ort an unserem Standort in Berlin. Für die nötige Flexibilität in deiner Alltagsplanung - sei es für private Termine oder ungestörtes Arbeiten - bieten wir dir ein jährliches Kontingent von 26 Home-Office-Tagen. Deine Mobilität: Egal wie du zu uns kommst, wir unterstützen dich. Du hast die Wahl zwischen einem vergünstigten Jobticket oder einer Tankkarte. Zudem bieten wir dir ein Firmenrad-Leasing (JobRad) und eine gute ÖPNV-Anbindung. Zeit für Erholung: Du erhältst 28 Tage Urlaub und profitierst von unserem flexiblen Gleitzeitmodell. Weihnachten und Silvester sind bei uns grundsätzlich arbeitsfreie Tage, die nicht von deinem Urlaubskonto abgehen. Deine Entwicklung: Unsere unterschiedlichen Abteilungen mit internationalen Teams arbeiten an vielfältigen Projekten zusammen. Dadurch lernst Du permanent neue Sichtweisen, Tools und Prozesse kennen – inklusive aktuellster KI-Anwendungen im Performance Marketing. Kultur & Mitarbeitervorteile: Ein strukturiertes Onboarding, flache Hierarchien und attraktive Mitarbeiterrabatte warten auf dich. Bei uns gilt: Come as you are – fühl dich wohl und sei einfach du selbst! Klingt nach deinem nächsten Match? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung! title: Cloud Engineer - Quantum Computing (m/w/d)
description: eleQtron develops and operates full-stack quantum computers based on trapped-ion technology. Quantum computing is a new computing paradigm rapidly approaching commercial viability. Our unique approach combines laser-cooled trapped ions with microwave control and tailored magnetic fields. Our next-generation computing machines under development will be able to find solutions to problems that are out of reach today, thus enabling new innovative products and services for a brighter future. We are looking for a Cloud Engineer (m/f/d) to join us in Hamburg or Siegen and build and operate the scalable, secure cloud platform that connects users with our trapped-ion quantum computers. Responsibilities: You will join our Quantum firmware Team as a Cloud Engineer. You will build the layer through which the world reaches our quantum computers. Users submit quantum programs; your services compile, schedule, and dispatch them to our machines and return the results:   Build and operate the cloud services that let users submit quantum programs to our systems and retrieve their results. Develop and deploy our compilation pipeline as a scalable cloud service , from circuit input through transpilation down to hardware-level instructions Design and maintain the public API and SDK entry points to our platform  Implement job queuing, scheduling, and dispatch towards the hardware backends, including quota, prioritisation, and result handling  Own authentication and authorisation across the platform: user and tenant identity, API keys and tokens, and role-based access to machines, jobs, and results, built on an established identity provider rather than from scratch Guarantee tenant isolation, so that quantum programs and results are never visible across customer boundaries, and manage secrets and credentials across the stack Work with the quantum firmware and hardware teams on the interfaces between cloud services and the machine itself Instrument the platform for observability and keep an eye on latency, throughput, and cost Required Skills: 3+ years of hands-on experience building and deploying backend or platform services in production Strong Python; additional systems-level language experience (Go, Rust, C++) is welcome Solid API design skills (REST and/or gRPC) for services other developers have to use Practical experience implementing authentication and authorisation in production systems: OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect, token handling, and role-based access control Secure engineering habits: least privilege by default, proper secrets management, and awareness of dependency and container supply-chain risks Infrastructure as code (Terraform, Pulumi, or similar) and CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, or similar) Working understanding of GDPR and data residency requirements, and a genuine interest in digital sovereignty Ability to collaborate effectively with experimental physicists and engineers Strong adaptability and a quick learning mindset Good proficiency in English (written and spoken); German is an advantage for working with public-sector partners Nice to have (Bonus) Running an identity provider in production (Keycloak, Zitadel, Ory, Authentik, or a managed IAM service) Multi-tenant isolation patterns in SaaS platforms Contributing to security certification work (ISO 27001, BSI IT-Grundschutz, BSI C5) or acting on penetration test findings Familiarity with quantum SDKs and toolchains (Qiskit, Cirq, PennyLane, QIR) or hardware abstraction interfaces such as QDMI Batch scheduling or HPC environments (Slurm or similar) Observability stacks such as Prometheus, Grafana, or OpenTelemetry Prior exposure to quantum computing or other deep-tech domains What you can expect from eleQtron: Competitive salary: We value our team members and therefore provide remunerations that reflect this, additionally rewarding achievements Flexible working hours : We offer personal freedom through a variety of flexible work schedules Team spirit: In our international and diverse team, and with our regular team events, having fun at work is simply part of the culture Further development: We want to grow together and so we offer our team members needs-based, individualized further training as well as plenty of room for personal development Wellness Package : We offer health-promoting benefits such as fitness programs like UrbanSportsClub to support your well-being Bike Leasing: Stay Mobile and Sustainable with Our Company Bike Leasing Program Moving Benefits: A warm welcome! title: Managing Director / Country Head (m/w/d) Deutschland
description: Bereit, den Markt zu verändern? PAIR Finance denkt Inkasso neu: Wir entwickeln die fortschrittlichste KI-Technologie im Forderungsmanagement und haben damit die gesamte Inkassoindustrie nachhaltig verändert. Heute sind wir mit 250+ Mitarbeitenden, 600+ Mandant*innen und Standorten in zehn europäischen Städten europaweit führend im Einsatz von KI im Forderungsmanagement – und erzielen dabei höhere Rückzahlungsquoten, ohne die Kundenbeziehung unserer Mandant*innen zu belasten. Im Zuge der Ausgliederung entsteht die PAIR Finance Deutschland GmbH als eigenständige operative Gesellschaft für unseren Heimatmarkt. Als Managing Director / Country Head (m/w/d) Deutschland übernimmst du die unternehmerische und vertriebliche Verantwortung für diesen Aufbau: Deutschland ist der am weitesten entwickelte Markt unserer europaweit tätigen Gruppe – deine Aufgabe ist es, ihn weiter zu skalieren, zu professionalisieren und profitabel auszubauen. Du gestaltest die nächste Wachstumsphase der deutschen Gesellschaft aktiv mit. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.</p></div><h2><strong>About the role</strong></h2> <p>We are looking for software engineers to help build the foundational pieces for safety, oversight and intervention mechanisms of our AI systems. This role will focus on building systems to detect unwanted model behaviors and prevent disallowed use of models. You will apply your technical skills to uphold our principles of safety, transparency, and oversight.</p> <h2><strong>Responsibilities:</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Develop the foundational systems which power Safeguards, including infrastructure for data storage and management, metric and evaluation systems, and tooling for human and agentic review.</li> <li>Ensure the day-to-day running of Safeguards systems and hold a high operational bar which serves both safety and customers while reducing the amount of human intervention and oversight required.</li> <li>Build robust and reliable multi-layered defenses for real-time improvement of safety mechanisms that work at scale</li> </ul> <h2><strong>You may be a good fit if you have:</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or comparable professional experience</li> <li>Proficiency in Python</li> <li>Ability to work across the stack</li> <li>Strong communication skills and ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Strong candidates may also:</strong></h2> <ul> <li>7+ years of experience in a software engineering position</li> <li>Have experience building trust and safety, anti-spam, fraud or abuse detection and mitigation mechanisms and interventions for AI/ML systems</li> <li>Have experience building metrics and measurement systems or data and privacy management systems</li> <li>Have worked closely with operational teams to build custom internal tooling</li> <li>Be proficient in TypeScript or Rust</li> <li>Have experience with Claude Code or similar agentic coding tools</li> </ul> <p><strong>Deadline to apply: </strong>None. However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. title: Senior Commercial Counsel
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>Who Are We?</strong></h2> <p>Postman is the world’s leading API platform, used by more than 45 million+ developers and 500,000 organizations, including 98% of the Fortune 500. Postman is helping developers and professionals across the globe build the API-first world by simplifying each step of the API lifecycle and streamlining collaboration—enabling users to create better APIs, faster.</p> <p>The company is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Boston, New York, Austin, Tokyo, London, and Bangalore - where Postman was founded. Postman is privately held, with funding from Battery Ventures, BOND, Coatue, CRV, Insight Partners, and Nexus Venture Partners. Learn more at postman.com or connect with Postman on X via ----- <p>P.S: We highly recommend reading <a href="https://api-first-world.com/">The "API-First World" graphic novel</a> to understand the bigger picture and our vision at Postman.</p></div><h2><strong>The Opportunity</strong></h2> <p>Postman's international business is growing rapidly, driven by enterprise adoption, an expanding partner ecosystem, and deepening relationships with the world's largest technology organizations across EMEA, APAC, and emerging markets. As Sr Commercial Counsel, you will be Postman's first dedicated international commercial legal hire, owning the legal work that supports this growth while operating as an extension of the US-based Commercial Legal team.</p> <p>Reporting to the Managing Counsel, Commercial, you will serve as the primary legal partner for Postman's commercial and partnerships teams outside the Americas. Your manager is based in the US (New York City), and the role is designed for a high degree of autonomy during EMEA and APAC business hours, with regular touchpoints during overlapping hours to stay aligned on priorities, positions, and escalations. You will draft, negotiate, and close enterprise and mid-market SaaS agreements, partner and channel deals, and cross-border commercial transactions, with primary focus on EMEA and shared responsibility for APAC. You will also help shape how Postman's commercial legal function operates internationally, adapting US contracting standards, playbooks, and processes for global markets while maintaining consistency across the legal team. This is a high-visibility role for a commercial lawyer who wants to help build an international legal function, not just maintain one.</p> <h2><strong>What You'll Do</strong></h2> <h3><strong>Commercial Contracting and Partner Support</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Serve as lead counsel for Postman's international commercial transactions outside the Americas, with primary focus on EMEA and shared coverage of APAC enterprise and mid-market deal flow.</li> <li>Draft, review, and negotiate subscription agreements, order forms, and related deal documents with large global and mid-size enterprises on both Postman paper and counterparty paper.</li> <li>Manage a high-velocity deal pipeline spanning multiple regions and time zones, partnering directly with Sales, Deal Operations, and Finance to close complex deals at the pace the business requires.</li> <li>Apply and adapt Postman's established US contracting standards, templates, and playbooks to international transactions, ensuring global consistency while addressing local legal, regulatory, and commercial requirements.</li> <li>Advise on deal structuring, pricing models, and commercial risk across EMEA and APAC jurisdictions.</li> <li>Support the legal workstream for international partner, channel, and alliance agreements, including technology partnerships, reseller and distribution arrangements, marketplace terms, co-sell and referral terms, and co-marketing agreements.</li> <li>Contribute to the scaling of Postman's global partner program by building frameworks, templates, and processes that work across jurisdictions.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>International and Cross-Border Legal Support</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Navigate cross-border commercial issues that arise when a US-headquartered platform sells and partners internationally, including data transfer mechanisms, local regulatory considerations, and multi-entity deal structures.</li> <li>Collaborate with the US Commercial Legal team to maintain alignment on contracting positions, escalation protocols, and legal operations processes.</li> <li>Coordinate with external counsel in EMEA and APAC jurisdictions as needed for local law advice on specific transactions or regulatory questions.</li> <li>Contribute to global Legal team initiatives, including template development, process improvements, and enablement.</li> <li>Provide practical, commercially-minded guidance that enables internal stakeholders to move quickly and make informed decisions.</li> <li>Act as a resource for business teams based outside of the Americas on day-to-day commercial legal questions, building trust as an accessible and responsive legal partner.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About You</strong></h2> <h3><strong>Required Qualifications</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Qualified solicitor or barrister in England and Wales (or equivalent UK legal qualification) in good standing.</li> <li>Law degree (LLB, JD, or equivalent).</li> <li>7-10 years of legal experience, including substantial in-house experience at a technology company, with significant time spent on B2B enterprise and mid-market SaaS commercial transactions.</li> <li>Direct experience drafting and negotiating partner, channel, and alliance agreements, with a working understanding of technology partnership program structures, including reseller models, marketplace distribution, referral arrangements, and OEM licensing.</li> <li>Experience working on cross-border commercial transactions within a US-headquartered company's legal framework, including familiarity with US-style contracting conventions, escalation norms, and playbook-driven processes.</li> <li>Ability to work independently across EMEA and APAC time zones while maintaining close alignment with a US-based legal team on contracting standards, positions, and priorities.</li> <li>Ability to manage a high volume of concurrent transactions with speed and sound judgment, balancing risk with commercial momentum across multiple regions.</li> <li>Strong commercial instinct and the ability to translate business objectives into contract language that protects Postman while enabling deals to close.</li> <li>Clear, confident communicator who builds strong relationships with business stakeholders across time zones and functions.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Preferred Qualifications</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Familiarity with US commercial contracting conventions and legal frameworks (formal US bar admission a plus but not required)&nbsp;</li> <li>Prior in-house experience at a high-growth SaaS, developer tools, or API-focused technology company.</li> <li>Experience supporting cloud marketplace transactions or technology partnerships.</li> <li>Familiarity with AI-related commercial terms, including model-as-a-service licensing, usage-based pricing, and AI governance provisions.</li> <li>Familiarity with APAC and EMEA data protection requirements as they apply to commercial and partner agreements, including international data transfer mechanisms.</li> <li>Experience building or localizing contract templates, playbooks, or legal operations processes for new regions.</li> <li>Working knowledge of commercial legal requirements across multiple EMEA and APAC jurisdictions beyond the UK.</li> <li>Proficiency with AI tools applied to legal workflows (contract review, research, drafting, process design).</li> <li>Experience with CLM platforms (Ironclad or similar).</li> <li>Comfort with API and developer-platform concepts, with the ability to develop product fluency quickly and advise on product-adjacent commercial issues.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What Success Looks Like</strong></h2> <p>You will have established yourself as the trusted commercial legal partner for Postman's international GTM teams, with full ownership of EMEA enterprise and mid-market deal flow and established coverage of APAC commercial transactions. You will have developed a strong working cadence with the US Commercial Legal team, consistently applying Postman's global contracting standards while confidently handling jurisdiction-specific legal and regulatory considerations across both regions. You will have localized or adapted key commercial templates and playbooks for international use. Your Sales and Partner team stakeholders across EMEA and APAC will rely on you as someone who understands their deals, moves at their pace, and adds value beyond redlines.&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h2 data-renderer-start-pos="4036"><strong data-renderer-mark="true">What Else?</strong></h2> <p data-renderer-start-pos="4048">In addition to Postman's pay-on-performance philosophy, and a flexible schedule working with a fun, collaborative team, Postman offers a comprehensive set of benefits, including full medical coverage, flexible PTO, wellness reimbursement, and a monthly lunch stipend. Along with that, our wellness programs will help you stay in the best of your physical and mental health. Our frequent and fascinating team-building events will keep you connected, while our donation-matching program can support the causes you care about. We’re building a long-term company with an inclusive culture where everyone can be the best version of themselves.&nbsp;</p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="4048">At Postman we value in person collaboration. We are in office 5 days a week for all roles based out of our hubs in San Francisco Bay Area, Boston, Austin, New York City, Tokyo and London. For roles based in Bangalore, employees currently work in the office three days a week and will transition to five days per week by the end of the year. We were thoughtful in our approach which is based on collaboration and grounded in feedback from our workforce, leadership team, and peers. The benefits of our in office model will be shared knowledge, brainstorming sessions, communication, and building trust in-person that cannot be replicated via zoom.</p> <h2 data-renderer-start-pos="3620"><strong data-renderer-mark="true">Our Values</strong></h2> <p data-renderer-start-pos="3633">At Postman, we create with the same curiosity that we see in our users. We value transparency and honest communication about not only successes, but also failures. In our work, we focus on specific goals that add up to a larger vision. Our inclusive work culture ensures that everyone is valued equally as important pieces of our final product. We are dedicated to delivering the best products we can.</p> <h2><strong>Equal opportunity</strong></h2> <p data-renderer-start-pos="4048">Postman is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status. Headhunters and recruitment agencies may not submit resumes/CVs through this website or directly to managers. Postman does not accept unsolicited headhunter and agency resumes. Postman will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with Postman.</p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><p><a href="https://fin.ai/">Fin</a>, now part of Salesforce, is on a mission to help businesses provide perfect customer experiences.</p> <p>Our AI Agent Fin is the highest-performing AI Customer Agent on the market today, enabling businesses to deliver impeccable, always-on customer support across the customer journey, from service, to sales, to ecommerce. Powered by our own AI models, Fin resolves complex customer issues end-to-end across every channel, with minimal set-up and integration. Fin can also be combined with our natively integrated Intercom help desk, giving modern support teams one single system.</p> <p>Together with Salesforce, the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success, we're building the future of customer experience. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword, it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing, and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI.</p> <p>Ready to level up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place. Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.</p></div><h2><strong>Why you should join Fin today</strong></h2> <p>AI is transforming everything—fast. We’re at the forefront, shaping the AI Agent category and redefining customer service with Fin. Soon, Fin will handle the vast majority of customer interactions, setting a new standard for support.<br><br>This shift isn’t just changing what we build—it’s changing how we work. Our team is constantly evolving, integrating AI into design, development, and go-to-market strategies.</p> <p>At Fin, design is in our DNA. With 60+ designers across R&amp;D and Brand and two co-founders from design, you’ll never have to fight for your place at the table.</p> <p>Here,&nbsp;designers lead from the start, shaping products that millions of people interact with daily. If you want to work on cutting-edge AI experiences that push the boundaries of product&nbsp;design, there’s no better place to be.</p> <h2><strong>Why this role exists</strong></h2> <p>In a world where it’s easier and easier to get software off the ground and to 75% built, it’s the last 25% that really matters. We need deep craft specialists—people who will raise the&nbsp;quality bar, bring a spark of creativity, drive best-in-class interaction and visual design, and push execution excellence across our most strategic product areas.</p> <p>This is not a strategy-only or people-management role. We need a maker, a doer, a leader in craft.</p> <p>If you have a deep passion for interaction design, product thinking, and pixel-perfect execution—and the leadership and autonomy to drive impact without waiting for&nbsp;direction—this is the role for you.</p> <h2><strong>Must Have Experience</strong></h2> <p>We’re looking for a world-class IC designer who:</p> <ul> <li>Has shipped complex, high-quality software products.</li> <li>Designs for multiple surfaces—desktop, mobile, chat interfaces, AI first and emerging experiences.</li> <li>Balances speed and detail—knows when to move fast and when to obsess over&nbsp;the last 1%.</li> <li>Thinks end-to-end—from big-picture systems thinking to the smallest interaction&nbsp;detail.</li> <li>Understands engineering and can build prototypes to communicate ideas (Framer,&nbsp;Loveable, Windsurf, Vercel, Figma, code etc...).</li> <li>Has taste. In the AI era, our role has elevated: as AI agents like our own Apollo take on more of the technical build, our people focus on the work that drives real impact—understanding our customers' business-critical problems, designing the solutions that solve them, and quantifying the value delivered. Our Deployment Engineers and Deployment Architects pair deep domain and industry expertise with serious platform mastery and AI-augmented delivery, directing agentic systems while owning the judgment, architecture, and customer relationships that AI cannot replace. You bridge the gap between pre-sales and post-sales, ensuring that what was promised can be delivered - and often shaping the promise itself.</p> <p>This role carries significant organizational leverage. You set delivery patterns that other teams follow. You define how AI agents should be orchestrated for complex, multi-workstream engagements. Engineering</li> <li>Review Solution(s) Blueprint to ensure quality, scalability and production readiness of business critical and operational use cases</li> </ul> <p><strong>Domain &amp; Industry Depth</strong></p> <ul> <li>Develop and maintain deep expertise in one or more process domains (e.g., Supply Chain, Order to Cash, Procure to Pay, IT Service Management) or industry verticals</li> <li>Translate domain knowledge into scalable solution patterns, reference architectures, and best practices that the broader team can leverage</li> <li>Proactively identify and standardize high-value use cases within your domain in collaboration with the Deployment Engineer, collaborating with Product and Business Apps teams to shape the platform roadmap</li> </ul> <p><strong>Practice Development</strong></p> <ul> <li>Contribute to hiring: define what great looks like for the Deployment job family, conduct interviews, and calibrate candidate assessments</li> <li>Share knowledge across the organization through internal enablement sessions, documentation, and community of practice leadership</li> <li>Ensure the link with Product &amp; Engineering to feed customer insights and field experience back into platform development, and to influence the platform roadmap</li> </ul> <p><strong>What Distinguishes This Role from Deployment Engineer</strong></p> <ul> <li>Scope: You work across multiple engagements and shape solutions across a portfolio/cluster/industry vertical (4+ concurrent clients)</li> <li>Influence &amp; description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.</strong></p> <p>Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.</p> <p>Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.</p> <p>As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.</p> <p>We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.</p> <p>Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.</p></div><p><strong>About the Role:&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>As a Pre-Sales Solutions Architect, you'll demonstrate the value of Planet's data and services to help organizations within the Western and Northern European regions overcome their earth data challenges. You'll also collaborate with internal cross-functional teams, including Customer Success, Product Management, and Business Development, to act as the voice of the customer to enhance Planet's industry offerings.</p> <p>The ideal candidate is passionate about Earth observation and enjoys helping customers get most out of their work. This role will appeal to candidates who don’t mind frequent international travel (primarily around Europe) and are comfortable working in the defense and intelligence sector.</p> <p>This is a full-time, remote position based in France or the United Kingdom. This role requires frequent international travel up to 50%. If located near an office, you are expected to work from that office 3 days per week.</p> <p><strong>Impact You’ll Own:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build and deliver presentations and product demonstrations highlighting technical capabilities of Planet’s platform and our ability to fulfill customer’s business needs.</li> <li>Create relationships with customers’ technical and management staff as a trusted advisor to their business.</li> <li>Act as an advisor to the customer to recommend a solutions architecture that fits their business challenges.</li> <li>Assist with the response to tenders, RFI’s and RFP’s proposals with respect to product/solution information.</li> <li>Work with your sales team colleagues to determine account development plans and execute a strategy to engage customers and prospects.</li> <li>Collaborate with internal cross-functional teams including Customer Success, Product Management, and Business Development to act as the voice of the customer, assist with RFP and RFI preparation and submissions.</li> <li>Attain quarterly and annual sales and operational objectives assigned by management.</li> <li>Represent Planet’s Defense and Intelligence needs to Sales leadership, in communicating forecasts, pipeline opportunities, deal reviews, data in CRM tools, and customer feedback.</li> <li>Present to key executive Government stakeholders within the Western and Northern Europe Regions.</li> <li>Act as a mentor to team members and lead training to drive their development.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You Bring:</strong></p> <ul> <li>6+ years of experience in supporting the Defense community within the European region.</li> <li>Bachelor’s degree in a related field.</li> <li>Have the ability to obtain and maintain a security clearance for meeting with regional customers.</li> <li>Ability to travel internationally up to 50%, primarily around Europe and the United States.</li> <li>Excellent verbal and written communication skills in French.</li> ISR, and related fields.</li> <li>Experience with QGIS, SocetGXP, ArcGIS, GDAL and other common geospatial software packages.</li> <li>Ability to successfully communicate and coordinate with international customers &amp; sales team.</li> <li>Excellent problem-solving skills and proactive working style.</li> <li>Ability to multitask, prioritize and manage time effectively.</li> <li>Ability to program with Python to process imagery, manipulate vector data, interact with APIs and build data pipelines.</li> <li>Ability to lead customer engagements.</li> <li>Ability to run workshops or training sessions with users.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Application Deadline:</strong></p> <p class="p1">October 26, 2026 by 11:59p / 23:59 CET (Central European Time)</p> <p><strong>Export Control description: <div class="content-intro"><p>For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it’s what we show up for every day.</p></div><p>You independently lead the most complex AI deployments Smartsheet undertakes. You own the full engagement lifecycle from technical discovery through production deployment through solutions org handoff. You architect multi-agent solutions, design client-personalized MCP resource packs, and build the Deployment Kits that transform how 200+ solutions consultants and partners operate. You mentor junior FDEs, drive the intelligence loop, and present field findings at weekly Applied AI strategy sessions. You are building a function, not filling a role.</p> <p><strong>What You Will Do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead complex, multi-system AI deployments end-to-end scope, architect, build, validate, and manage the customer relationship throughout.</li> <li>Own the AI workshop program for your pod, customize modules per customer, lead technical sessions, translate outputs into production requirements, evolve content from field learning.</li> <li>Architect multi-agent solutions selecting the right coordination pattern for each customer’s workflow characteristics and compliance requirements.</li> <li>Design client-specific and industry-specific MCP resource packs that serve personalized intelligence from the server so every connected AI surface gets smarter for that customer automatically.</li> <li>Own Deployment Kit quality for your pod. If a kit is not documented well enough for a solutions consultant with no engineering background to follow, it isn’t done.</li> <li>Lead Solutions Enablement Sprints: transfer AI deployment patterns to solutions consultants and partners with training materials and certification criteria.</li> <li>Drive the intelligence loop: author strategic memos, present field findings weekly, contribute Agent Bricks and Skills, file RFCs for platform improvements.</li> <li>Mentor junior FDEs on customer engagements, code reviews, and Deployment Kit quality.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Required</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>6–10+ years production software engineering, </strong>including 3+ years deploying AI/ML to production. Deep Python; strong TypeScript/JavaScript.</li> <li><strong>Proven track record leading complex enterprise technical engagements. </strong>You’ve managed customer relationships, navigated security reviews, and delivered production systems organisations depend on.</li> <li><strong>Deep production LLM experience: </strong>multi-agent orchestration, MCP/tool-use, RAG optimisation, evaluation frameworks, agent deployment at scale.</li> <li><strong>System architecture expertise </strong>spanning enterprise systems, cloud infrastructure, and AI services explainable to a CIO and a junior engineer.</li> <li><strong>Demonstrated ability to create reusable technical assets </strong>that others use in production. You think in platforms, not projects.</li> <li><strong>Strong written and verbal communication. </strong>Architecture documents, runbooks, strategic memos, training materials. Your Deployment Kits are your portfolio.</li> <li><strong>You leave teams better than you found them.</strong> You make sure the people you work with understand what was built, why it works, and how to own it without you.</li> <li><strong>Ability to travel. </strong>&nbsp;This role requires domestic and international travel approximately 25–50% of the time.</li> <li>Elligible to work in the UK on an ongoing basis</li> <li>BS or MS in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent industry experience</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Nice to Have:&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience founding or scaling an FDE/solutions engineering function.&nbsp;</li> <li>Technical founder background. Databricks, AWS Bedrock, or Temporal experience.&nbsp;</li> <li>Deep domain knowledge in healthcare, financial services, or government. Agent framework contributions (Strands SDK, LangChain, open-source MCP servers).</li> <li>Proficiency in German/French language will be an added advantage</li> <li>Familiarity of AI governance, ethics, and regulatory requirements (e.g. GDPR, UK/EU AI Act)&nbsp;</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Get to Know Us:</strong></p> <p>At Smartsheet, your ideas are heard, your potential is supported, and your contributions have real impact. You’ll have the freedom to explore, push boundaries, and grow beyond your role. We welcome diverse perspectives and nontraditional paths—because we know that impact comes from individuals who care deeply and challenge thoughtfully. When you’re doing work that stretches you, excites you, and connects you to something bigger, that’s magic at work. Let’s build what’s next, together.</p> <p><strong>Equal Opportunity Employer:</strong></p> <p>Smartsheet is an Equal Opportunity (EEO) employer committed to fostering an inclusive environment with the best employees. It is our policy to provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants in accordance with applicable laws in the US, UK, Australia, Germany, Costa Rica, Japan, Bulgaria, India, and Singapore. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran or disabled status, or genetic information.&nbsp;</p> <p>If there are preparations we can make to help ensure you have a comfortable and positive interview experience, please let us know.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">#LI-Remote</span></p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

raw.description:
About Lendable

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

  • One of the UK’s newest unicorns with a team of just over 700 people

  • Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

  • Profitable since 2017

  • Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

  • Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot)

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

Join us if you want to

  1. Take ownership across a broad remit. You are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

  2. Work in small teams of exceptional people, who are relentlessly resourceful to solve problems and find smarter solutions than the status quo

  3. Build the best technology in-house, using new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

About the role

As Head of Compliance Monitoring, you'll own Lendable's risk-based compliance monitoring programme and lead the team that delivers it. You'll provide independent second line assurance that the business meets its legal and regulatory obligations, and evidence the outcomes customers actually receive rather than the processes behind them.

You'll report to the Head of Compliance (SMF 16, Compliance Oversight) and deputise for them, including at Board meetings and sub-committees. This is a senior, hands-on role for someone who has built a second line monitoring function in a UK FCA regulated consumer credit firm and wants the autonomy to shape one in a fast-growing fintech. The role is not itself a Senior Manager Function.

What you’ll be doing/impact on objectives

  • Own the compliance monitoring plan and methodology, refreshing it annually and in-year in response to emerging risks, regulatory change, MI, complaints and FCA publications

  • Maintain a monitoring universe covering PRIN and the Consumer Duty, CONC, SYSC, DISP, SMCR, MCOB, the Consumer Credit Act, financial promotions and UK GDPR

  • Scope and deliver thematic and BAU reviews across the customer journey, including affordability (CONC 5), financial promotions (CONC 3), arrears and forbearance (CONC 7), vulnerability, fees and charges and complaints handling (DISP)

  • Test the design and operating effectiveness of first line controls, and provide second line assurance over first line quality assurance

  • Issue clear, evidence-based reports setting out findings, root cause, risk ratings and owned actions, then track remediation to closure and validate that it worked

  • Escalate actual or potential customer harm promptly, and assess it for redress and for notification to the FCA under Principle 11 and SUP 15

  • Produce monitoring MI for the Head of Compliance, executive management and the Board, and present it at committees

  • Support FCA supervisory engagement, information requests and skilled person (s166) reviews, and coordinate coverage with Internal Audit, Risk and first line QA

  • Bring data protection into scope, testing UK GDPR and DPA 2018 compliance alongside the Data Protection Officer

  • Lead, coach and develop the compliance monitoring team, planning resource against the plan and building capability through data, analytics and better tooling

What we’re looking for

  • Demonstrable compliance monitoring experience within a UK FCA regulated firm, including designing, owning and delivering a risk-based compliance monitoring programme

  • Experience of leading, managing and developing a team

  • Consumer credit experience, with a strong working knowledge of CONC and the Consumer Credit Act

  • Strong working knowledge of the FCA Handbook, in particular PRIN and the Consumer Duty, SYSC, DISP and SMCR, and of FCA expectations of a second line monitoring function

  • Data protection knowledge, covering the UK GDPR and the Data Protection Act 2018

  • Ability to write clear, concise, evidence-based reports and to present findings credibly to senior management, the Board and its committees

  • Sound judgement and personal resilience, with the independence and confidence to challenge the business constructively and to escalate where necessary

  • Strong planning and organisational skills, with the ability to deliver a plan across competing priorities

Highly desirable

  • Internal audit experience gained in a third line function, and/or a relevant professional qualification (for example IIA, ICA or CISI)

  • Secured lending experience, from either a second or third line perspective, including knowledge of MCOB

 

Interview process

  • Screening stage: a 15 minute remote cognitive exercise and a 30 minute interview with the Talent Partner

  • 40 minute interview with a Compliance Business Partner (remote)

  • Final onsite interview:

    • 45minute interview with the Head of Compliance

    • 30 minute interviews with CRO

    • 30 minute interview with a product MD

Life at Lendable

  • Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

  • Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites

  • Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls

  • Health coverage: support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health cover

  • Retirement & savings: long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plans

  • Employee referral programme: earn a competitive bonus when you refer successful new team members

  • Office meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations

  • Sustainable commuting: cycle-to-work and electric vehicle salary sacrifice schemes available in select locations

There is a surprising amount of leverage available here. Our systems generate terabytes of data and our engineers can inspect almost every part of what happens inside them, but getting to that information often still requires knowing which database to query, dashboard to open or machine to inspect. The same is true of engineering workflows: useful context is spread across code, production systems, internal messaging, incident notes and individual engineers. We want to make all of that much easier to use. The job is to work out where better tooling can remove meaningful friction, then build it properly. Sometimes that will mean a simple internal application. Sometimes it will mean using AI to review code, investigate production issues, query internal data or automate repetitive engineering work. The same applies to internal knowledge spread across code, documentation, internal messaging, incident notes and dashboards. We want that context to be easier to find and use, while still making it possible to get down to the raw source when needed. Internal tooling You’ll build the tools that remove friction from how people at Gattaca work. That might mean improving CI and deployment workflows, building better interfaces around existing systems, or replacing a manual process with something simple and reliable. Today, investigating an issue often means manually piecing together context from several places. We want to make that loop much tighter. Internal tooling is only useful if it makes people's work noticeably easier. We want someone who moves quickly, raises the standard around them, and keeps pushing important work forward without needing a queue of tickets. Skills we value, but aren’t a requirement Experience building AI agents, tool-using models, evaluation systems or model routing.
